title: Gate 2 pilot runtime contradictory QA
purpose: Prepare an implementation-independent executable runtime oracle for the owner-authorized GATE2_PILOT_READ_ONLY profile, then bind and rerun it only against one frozen exact OPS-WP-009 implementation head. QA never implements or repairs Gate 2 runtime.
invariants: Phase 1 is implementation-independent: no OPS-WP-009 internal implementation choices are inspected or encoded before a frozen exact implementation head is published.
No final PASS is permitted before the QA branch is synchronized by merge commit to one frozen exact OPS-WP-009 implementation head and the full oracle is rerun.
Gate 2 is explicit opt-in only; default Gate 1 behavior remains unchanged.
Dependency identity is never job_id-only and is bound by job_id, request_comment_id, request_sha256 and target_sha inside one repository/authority/request/session/generation/grant scope.

Fan-in is strict AND and every privileged authorization boundary reconstructs current dependency truth from stable GitHub evidence instead of cached RUNNABLE, cached predecessor truth, cached receipt truth or final_effect_guard alone.
After JOB_SELECTED but before JOB_STARTED, dependency invalidation yields no JOB_STARTED and zero Gate0 invocation.
After durable JOB_STARTED but before Gate0, dependency invalidation yields RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation and zero automatic replay.
BLOCKED, RECONCILING, GLOBAL_HOLD and RECOVERY_REQUIRED are never equivalent to EMPTY; COMPLETE requires every node SUCCEEDED with durable receipt truth.
Gate 2 remains one-job-at-a-time, read-only, static, no-dataflow and no-dynamic-request; Gate3 and Gate4 remain HOLD and no FULL_V6_SECURITY claim is accepted.
Gate0 remains exactly the four accepted operations and byte-identical to the preparation baseline.
Final regression gate requires Gate1 85/85 PASS, Gate0 80/80 PASS and full tests/ai_jobs with zero skip and zero xfail.
requiredEvidence: Exact QA baseline, merge-base, QA head and exactly six changed paths within scope.allowedPaths.
Malformed/canonical graph envelope, graph edit, wrong author/grant/scope/session/generation and weak identity references are rejected fail-closed.
Duplicate node/edge, missing dependency, direct/indirect cycles, canonical ordering and every closed bound are attacked at limit and limit+1.
FAILED, STALE, AMBIGUOUS, missing/edited/divergent receipt, deleted/edited outcome, wrong body digest, invalid Gate0 outcome, terminal mismatch and source mutation never satisfy dependency truth.

Boundary A probes receipt delete/edit, outcome delete/body mutation, wrong digest, failed inner Gate0 validation, terminal ambiguity, unstable read, descendant request mutation and graph mutation; all require JOB_STARTED absent and Gate0 invocation count zero.
Boundary B repeats the same mutation classes after durable JOB_STARTED and requires RECOVERY_REQUIRED, Gate0 invocation count zero and automatic replay zero.
Cached RUNNABLE, cached predecessor truth, cached receipt and final_effect_guard-only authorization mutants are explicitly killed.
BLOCKED, RECONCILING and GLOBAL_HOLD are non-empty; receipt reconciliation never replays Gate0; COMPLETE is exact; unstable double-scan fails closed.

Gate2 explicit opt-in, exact four Gate0 operations, one runtime job, no generic shell/argv, no repository write, no branch/commit/push/workflow-dispatch/merge/release/promotion, no automatic Codespace lifecycle, no dataflow/dynamic request/cross-boundary delegation, Gate3 HOLD, Gate4 HOLD and no FULL_V6 claim are enforced.

After frozen implementation publication, QA records the exact SHA, merges that SHA into this branch by merge commit only, opens a DRAFT QA PR targeting the implementation branch, and ensures the PR diff is exactly the six QA paths.
Final exact-head run includes full tests/ai_jobs, Gate1 85/85, Gate0 80/80, zero skip/xfail and Gate0 byte identity.
nonGoals: Implementing or repairing tools/ai_jobs/fanin.py, run.py, __init__.py or any OPS-WP-009 path.
Modifying Gate0, Gate1 read-only files, workflows, governance, design, QA-WP-013 or its fixtures.
Inspecting implementation internals before a frozen exact OPS-WP-009 head exists.
Authorizing repository writes, automatic Codespace lifecycle, parallel execution, dynamic request generation, predecessor-output dataflow, Gate3, Gate4 or FULL_V6_SECURITY.
rollback: Discard or revert only the six QA-WP-014 paths. No Gate0, Gate1, Gate2 runtime, parent implementation, design, workflow, governance or product behavior is modified.
adversarialTests: Reject malformed or non-canonical Gate2 graph envelopes, duplicate JSON keys, forbidden numeric forms, edited graph comments, wrong graph author and graph payload digest mismatch.
Reject wrong repository, authority issue, request issue, session, generation, grant comment/digest and any dependency identity weaker than job_id + request_comment_id + request_sha256 + target_sha.
Reject duplicate node identities, duplicate dependency edges, missing dependencies, direct cycles, indirect cycles and non-canonical node/depends_on ordering.
Exercise payload, node, edge, fan-in, fan-out and depth bounds at the exact limit and at limit+1.
Require strict AND dependency truth: partial fan-in is never runnable; COMPLETED without a valid receipt remains BINDING_PENDING/RECONCILING.
Prove FAILED, STALE and AMBIGUOUS predecessors never satisfy descendants.

Invalidate dependency truth for deleted/edited/divergent receipts, deleted/edited outcomes, same-comment-id outcome body mutation, wrong body digest, failed Gate0 inner outcome validation, terminal mismatch/non-uniqueness and source-request mutation.

At Boundary A, mutate receipt, outcome, terminal authority, stable-read result, descendant request and graph after JOB_SELECTED but before JOB_STARTED; require no JOB_STARTED and Gate0 invocation count zero.
At Boundary B, repeat the same mutation surface after durable JOB_STARTED but before Gate0; require RECOVERY_REQUIRED, Gate0 invocation count zero and automatic replay zero.
Kill cached RUNNABLE, cached predecessor-truth, cached-receipt and final_effect_guard-only authorization shortcuts.
Prove BLOCKED, RECONCILING, GLOBAL_HOLD and RECOVERY_REQUIRED are not EMPTY and COMPLETE is exact only when every node is SUCCEEDED with durable receipt truth.
Reconcile terminal-COMPLETED-before-receipt without Gate0 replay and fail closed on divergent receipt candidates or unstable double scans.
Preserve deterministic Gate1 election order among simultaneously runnable nodes and exactly one runtime job at a time.

Reject repository write, generic shell/argv, branch/commit/push/workflow-dispatch/merge/release/promotion, automatic Codespace lifecycle, dynamic requests, predecessor-output dataflow, cross-session/generation/authority delegation, Gate3/Gate4 expansion and FULL_V6_SECURITY claims.
Require exact four Gate0 operations, explicit Gate2 opt-in, unchanged default Gate1 behavior, Gate1 85/85, Gate0 80/80, zero skip/xfail and byte-identical Gate0 before any final PASS.
Phase-2 QA must import and exercise the frozen runtime boundary/contract/profile code; a self-contained phase-1 model alone is insufficient for final runtime PASS.
independentReview: Phase 1 oracle was prepared from the accepted Gate2 design, owner constraints and existing Gate1 runtime before inspection of OPS-WP-009 implementation internals.
The phase-1 QA head was mechanically rebound by merge commit to frozen OPS-WP-009 implementation head 991b844e25364b6059aed34d6d1dd52deb7f28d5; implementation files remain read-only to QA.
QA review PR #195 is DRAFT and targets ops/OPS-WP-009-gate2-pilot-runtime at the frozen implementation head; QA may not merge directly to main.
Any implementation-head change invalidates the current binding and requires a new exact-head merge binding plus complete rerun.
A final PASS is permitted only from fresh executable evidence on the exact combined QA head; historical Gate1/Gate0 results may not substitute for exact-head execution.
Any runtime defect discovered by this oracle must be reported as HOLD; QA-WP-014 never repairs OPS-WP-009.

Exact-head Codespace execution on QA head 6b23177d63c4217199fecd95971448313c71c258 proved compile/import PASS, Gate1 85/85 PASS, Gate0 80/80 PASS and Gate0 byte identity; the only failures were undefined QA-oracle helpers, so the runtime implementation remains frozen while QA-owned tests are corrected.
